name: bing-ads-client-report
description: Use when someone asks for a monthly Microsoft Ads report for a client, wants the Bing section of a client deck built, needs last month's Microsoft Ads performance written up, asks for an end-of-month Bing Ads report, asks "what do I tell the client about Bing", or asks how to present a Microsoft Ads target they missed — even when they never say the word "report". For agencies and in-house teams reporting upward. Microsoft Ads (Bing) only.
